```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      cache = FALSE, fig.align = "center")
```

# Purpose

A self-contained re-run of the two Stage 2 experiments behind Predictions 2 and 3,
on the same pipeline used everywhere else (no `source()`). It recomputes the
training-window-length and store-type gains live so they can be checked against
the thesis tables (`tab:stage2_window`, `tab:stage2_type`) and any stale value
caught, the way the number-of-stores experiment was re-checked in Stage 6.

# 1. Packages, data, pipeline

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse); library(lubridate); library(xgboost); library(lightgbm)
TRAIN_CSV <- "train.csv"; STORE_CSV <- "store.csv"
TEST_DAYS <- 42; VAL_FRAC <- 0.15; SEED <- 42
N_THREADS <- max(1L, parallel::detectCores() - 1L); set.seed(SEED)
```

```{r load}
train_raw <- read_csv(TRAIN_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE) %>% mutate(Date = as.Date(Date))
store_raw <- read_csv(STORE_CSV, show_col_types = FALSE)
df <- train_raw %>% filter(Open == 1, Sales > 0) %>% left_join(store_raw, by = "Store") %>%
  mutate(Year=year(Date), Month=month(Date), Week=isoweek(Date), DayOfMonth=mday(Date),
         Quarter=quarter(Date), IsWeekend=as.integer(DayOfWeek %in% c(6,7)),
         StateHoliday=case_when(StateHoliday=="a"~1L,StateHoliday=="b"~2L,StateHoliday=="c"~3L,TRUE~0L),
         CompetitionOpenMonths=ifelse(!is.na(CompetitionOpenSinceYear)&!is.na(CompetitionOpenSinceMonth),
           (Year-CompetitionOpenSinceYear)*12+(Month-CompetitionOpenSinceMonth),NA_real_),
         CompetitionOpenMonths=pmax(CompetitionOpenMonths,0,na.rm=TRUE),
         StoreType=as.integer(factor(StoreType,levels=c("a","b","c","d"))),
         Assortment=as.integer(factor(Assortment,levels=c("a","b","c")))) %>%
  mutate(CompetitionDistance=replace_na(CompetitionDistance, median(CompetitionDistance,na.rm=TRUE)),
         CompetitionOpenMonths=replace_na(CompetitionOpenMonths,0)) %>%
  arrange(Date, Store)
FEAT_S1 <- c("Store","DayOfWeek","Promo","StateHoliday","SchoolHoliday","StoreType","Assortment",
             "CompetitionDistance","Promo2","Year","Month","Week","DayOfMonth","Quarter",
             "IsWeekend","CompetitionOpenMonths")
cat("rows:", nrow(df), "| stores:", n_distinct(df$Store), "\n")
```

```{r pipeline}
eval_rmse <- function(a,p) sqrt(mean((a-p)^2))
delta_rel <- function(ref,x) (ref-x)/ref*100

# split with an optional training-window length (in months); test = final 42 days
split_data <- function(data, feats, train_months = NULL) {
  d <- sort(unique(data$Date)); cutoff <- d[length(d) - TEST_DAYS]
  test <- data %>% filter(Date > cutoff)
  tr   <- data %>% filter(Date <= cutoff)
  if (!is.null(train_months)) tr <- tr %>% filter(Date > cutoff %m-% months(train_months))
  list(Xtr=as.matrix(tr[,feats]), ytr=tr$Sales, Xte=as.matrix(test[,feats]),
       yte=test$Sales, tr=tr, te=test)
}
val_idx <- function(tr){ d<-sort(unique(tr$Date)); cut<-d[floor(length(d)*(1-VAL_FRAC))]; which(tr$Date>cut) }

run_store_mean <- function(sp){ m<-sp$tr %>% group_by(Store) %>% summarise(mu=mean(Sales),.groups="drop")
  gm<-mean(sp$tr$Sales); p<-sp$te %>% left_join(m,by="Store") %>% mutate(p=coalesce(mu,gm)) %>% pull(p)
  eval_rmse(sp$yte,p) }
run_store_dow <- function(sp){ dm<-sp$tr %>% group_by(Store,DayOfWeek) %>% summarise(md=mean(Sales),.groups="drop")
  m<-sp$tr %>% group_by(Store) %>% summarise(mu=mean(Sales),.groups="drop"); gm<-mean(sp$tr$Sales)
  p<-sp$te %>% left_join(dm,by=c("Store","DayOfWeek")) %>% left_join(m,by="Store") %>%
     mutate(p=coalesce(md,mu,gm)) %>% pull(p); eval_rmse(sp$yte,p) }

run_xgb <- function(sp){ vi<-val_idx(sp$tr); ti<-setdiff(seq_along(sp$ytr),vi)
  pr<-list(objective="reg:squarederror",eta=0.10,max_depth=6,subsample=0.8,
           colsample_bytree=0.8,nthread=N_THREADS,verbosity=0)
  es<-xgb.train(pr,xgb.DMatrix(sp$Xtr[ti,],label=sp$ytr[ti]),nrounds=1500,
       watchlist=list(v=xgb.DMatrix(sp$Xtr[vi,],label=sp$ytr[vi])),early_stopping_rounds=50,verbose=0)
  fit<-xgb.train(pr,xgb.DMatrix(sp$Xtr,label=sp$ytr),nrounds=es$best_iteration,verbose=0)
  eval_rmse(sp$yte,predict(fit,xgb.DMatrix(sp$Xte))) }
run_lgb <- function(sp){ vi<-val_idx(sp$tr); ti<-setdiff(seq_along(sp$ytr),vi)
  pr<-list(objective="regression",metric="rmse",num_leaves=63,learning_rate=0.05,
           bagging_fraction=0.8,bagging_freq=1,feature_fraction=0.8,num_threads=N_THREADS,seed=SEED,verbosity=-1)
  es<-lgb.train(pr,lgb.Dataset(sp$Xtr[ti,],label=sp$ytr[ti]),nrounds=2000,
       valids=list(v=lgb.Dataset(sp$Xtr[vi,],label=sp$ytr[vi])),early_stopping_rounds=50,verbose=-1)
  fit<-lgb.train(pr,lgb.Dataset(sp$Xtr,label=sp$ytr),nrounds=es$best_iter,verbose=-1)
  eval_rmse(sp$yte,predict(fit,sp$Xte)) }

score <- function(sp){ rm<-run_store_mean(sp); rd<-run_store_dow(sp)
  rx<-run_xgb(sp); rl<-run_lgb(sp)
  tibble(naive_RMSE=round(rm), DOW_RMSE=round(rd), DOW_delta=round(delta_rel(rm,rd),1),
         XGB_RMSE=round(rx), XGB_drel=round(delta_rel(rm,rx),1),
         LGB_RMSE=round(rl), LGB_drel=round(delta_rel(rm,rl),1)) }
```

# 2. Prediction 2 — training-window length

Thesis (`tab:stage2_window`): XGB $\Delta_{\text{rel}}$ 29.8 / 49.1 / 47.2 / 48.3 / 48.9
and LGBM 36.8 / 49.9 / 47.7 / 48.9 / 47.6 for 6 / 12 / 18 / 24 / full months.

```{r pred2, cache=TRUE}
windows <- list("6 months"=6, "12 months"=12, "18 months"=18, "24 months"=24, "Full"=NULL)
pred2 <- imap_dfr(windows, function(m, nm) score(split_data(df, FEAT_S1, m)) %>% mutate(Window=nm, .before=1))
pred2
```

# 3. Prediction 3 — store-type composition

Thesis (`tab:stage2_type`): XGB $\Delta_{\text{rel}}$ 49.2 (A) / 61.7 (B) / 50.5 (A+B) / 46.9 (Full)
and LGBM 50.9 / 60.9 / 51.1 / 47.6.

```{r pred3, cache=TRUE}
# Each type alone (A,B,C,D) plus a balanced two-type mix (C+D) and the full sample.
# A+B is dropped: with only 17 Type-B stores against 602 Type-A, A+B is ~97% A.
subsets <- list("A only"=1L, "B only"=2L, "C only"=3L, "D only"=4L,
                "C+D"=c(3L,4L), "Full"=1:4)
pred3 <- imap_dfr(subsets, function(types, nm)
  score(split_data(df %>% filter(StoreType %in% types), FEAT_S1)) %>% mutate(Subset=nm, .before=1))
pred3
```

# 4. Read-off

```{r verdict}
cat("Pred 2: gain should jump from 6 to 12 months, then flatten (partially supported).\n")
cat("Pred 3: Type B (smallest, most distinctive weekly pattern) should show the LARGEST gain,\n",
    "       contradicting the homogeneity prediction but matching Var(delta).\n")
```
